name: Library Scan Progress & Visibility
changes: Runs user-initiated Automation library scans as background jobs with a lightweight progress endpoint instead of holding one long browser request open.
Shows live scan phase, real file/title counts, percentage, matched/change counts, current title/root, and an ETA once enough progress has been measured.
Uses an indeterminate Discovering files phase until the current directory traversal establishes a real file count, then switches to measured progress.
Serializes manual and scheduled library reconciliation so overlapping scans cannot walk the same large library concurrently.
Keeps scan progress visible across Automation redraws and item-dialog reopenings while preserving the existing reconciliation, quality, integrity-exclusion, and no-delete semantics.
regression_guards: The original synchronous /api/automation/library/scan route remains available for compatibility; the UI uses /scan/start plus GET /scan/progress.
Filesystem-derived scan state still merges through _merge_scan_state so newer import/download state wins over stale long-running scan results.
Library Integrity reviewed-fingerprint exclusions remain honored during TV and movie scans.
v3.6.44 Library Integrity GET audit route and v3.6.43 strict TV identity behavior remain intact.
v3.6.41 fail-soft Downloads snapshot and v3.6.20+ serialized private-SAB transport remain unchanged.
